plan.angle: The top 10 is static question lists from sign vendors and trainers (MySafetySign, OSHA.net, SmartSign, Red Hat Safety) plus one ProProfs quiz. This page lets a visitor play a sourced workplace safety quiz right here, then shows four workplaces running quizzes built from their own site rules: a new-hire quiz with a pass mark and retake, a toolbox talk quiz on phones, a hazard communication refresher scored by lab group, and a quiz after a fire drill. Every attempt lands in a database the company owns, and the FAQ gives question-writing and scoring advice the lists skip, with no claim that a quiz proves anyone works safely.
tab_stories: Coldbrook Mill Distribution gives each new hire a 10-question safety quiz on day one with a pass mark of 8; in March 26 of 31 passed first time, and supervisor Ondrej Salo got an email listing the missed questions for the 5 who retook it.

After the Monday toolbox talk on fall protection, 22 workers at a Halloran Sands Builders site answer 5 questions on their phones; 9 of 22 missed the question on when a harness is needed, so foreman Matthias Groult covered it again at the scaffold on Tuesday.

Quarrow Bioscience runs an 8-question refresher on labels and safety data sheets for 64 staff in 4 lab groups; the dashboard shows Synthesis averaging 5.9 of 8 against 7.0 or more elsewhere, and that group gets a session on reading the sheets for its own solvents.

After a fire drill at its 3 restaurants, Linnet Row Kitchens sends 140 staff a 6-question quiz on extinguishers and exits; 58 of 140 picked the wrong assembly point, and each manager posted a map by the back door.
